title: CERBERUS PROTOCOL
description: The final doors of NEXUS answer only to a Quantum Key. Forge one from your data fragments and read the Cerberus containment protocol.
goal: Forge the Quantum Key, then read the protocol hidden on CERBERUS.
hint: use data_fragment (needs 4)  ->  connect cerberus  ->  login protocol
story_start: VECTOR: "Fuse four fragments and you get a key that exists in several states at once. The core can't tell it from its own."
The CERBERUS console is waiting for a user named 'protocol'. It needs no password. Just the key.

objectives.hint: login protocol — the Quantum Key is the credential.

story_end: CERBERUS is not a power grid. It is a leash. And your name is on its list.

messages.text: AEGIS. Now. Alone. Credentials attached. I have something you need to see. — ARCHER
Please don't go. I'm begging you. He doesn't understand us.
